description: charm_composite_volume_probe: SnapPy complex-volume test of composite charmed-baryon braids vs heavy-baryon masses.
verdict: NO parameter-free composite-braid volume reproduces the charmed-baryon mass ratio. Near-coincidence Vol((s1s2^-1)^5)/Vol(Borromean)=2.332 vs Lambda_c/proton=2.437 (~4%) is DISQUALIFIED: (s1s2^-1)^5 is a KNOT (1 component), not a 3-quark baryon, and bottom (n=7) misses by ~40%. 3-component-correct candidates miss the charm ratio and closing the gap needs tuned twist count (=fit). Comparison also assumes mass~Vol (constant density), not the canonical absolute-mass law. m_c OPEN.
scope: (a) scope-limited negative under mass~Vol; SnapPy now available for principled follow-up (variable-density / projection).
